name: AK-47
description: 7.62x39 assault rifle with a 30-round magazine. Reliable, with heavy recoil. Ammo for it is common.

name: Hi-Power pistol
description: Old 9 mm service pistol. A backup for when your rifle is empty.

name: Combat knife
description: Leather-handled fighting knife. Silent, with no ammo to run out of.

name: K63 helmet
description: Heavy black helmet with a face visor. More protection than the MICH, but heavier.

name: MICH helmet
description: Modern combat helmet in a faded woodland cover. Lighter than the K63, no visor.

name: Plate carrier
description: Camo carrier with front and back plates and four magazine pouches. The heaviest item you'll wear, and the best protection.

name: Chest rig
description: Tan X-harness rig. Keeps magazines and meds within quick reach.

name: Daypack
description: Small camo pack. Enough room for a short raid.

name: Large patrol pack
description: Large frame pack. Holds a lot of loot, but adds a lot of weight when full.

name: 7.62x39 FMJ (30)
description: Full metal jacket rounds for the AK-47. The common type: good damage, average penetration.

name: Bandage
description: Stops bleeding. Small and light enough to carry a few.

name: Painkillers
description: Takes the edge off pain so you can keep moving. It doesn't heal you.

name: First aid kit
description: A full first aid kit. Restores health over a few seconds. Press H to use it.

name: Baked beans
description: A tin of baked beans. Keeps for years.

name: Sausage roll
description: Still in its paper bag, of uncertain age.

name: Bottled water
description: Sealed bottled water. More valuable than it used to be.

name: Can of cider
description: Warm and flat, but still worth something.

name: Roll of notes
description: A hundred pounds in tens. Light, small and valuable for its size.

name: Wristwatch
description: A decent watch from someone's bedside drawer. High value for its weight.

name: Smartphone
description: Dead and cracked. Worth something for its parts.

name: Concrete cow figurine
description: A miniature of Milton Keynes' concrete cows. Popular with collectors.

name: Laptop
description: Old work laptop. Heavy for its value, but easy to sell.

name: Copper wire
description: Stripped from the walls of the terraces. Always in demand.

name: Toolbox
description: Spanners, screwdrivers and a hammer. Useful, but heavy.

name: Car battery
description: Taken from a wrecked Corsa. Worth a fair amount, but it weighs 12 kg.
